title: Design: Empty Inactive tab message looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no inactive parts.
  • Make sure no search text and no filter is set on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.10 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Inactive tab.
  2. Click the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The column header row still shows (Description, Part Number, Tags …).
  • Under it, centred, one line of grey text reads "No inactive parts at this location."
  • The grey line is the only thing under the header row: no icon above it and no rows.

Step 2:

  • The Active tab lists the location's parts again, which shows the empty Inactive tab came from the data, not a broken page.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-N1: “If there are no inactive parts at the location and no search or filter is narrowing the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Inactive tab with no parts, nothing narrowing it | "No inactive parts at this location." | In place of the list”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
